title: Song Beyond

outfit_card.silhouette: A high-necked, asymmetrical jacket with wide bell sleeves paired with a short circular skirt. The layered construction features a translucent organza overskirt and ribbon sashes, creating a voluminous, fluttering profile.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Twin looped buns secured with gilded hairpins, small floral clips, and dangling red tassels. A delicate beaded chain rests across the forehead.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A high mandarin collar with a gold frog closure and teardrop cutout. The bodice combines dark olive velvet with a gradient peach silk panel, adorned with white crane embroidery. Sleeves are wide, layered bell shapes in sheer cream chiffon.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A short, pleated circular skirt in olive green with gold piping and crane motifs. A sheer, asymmetrical organza overlay extends to the knee. Sheer dark tights feature a prominent back-seam with a decorative bow and vertical line. Footwear is not visible.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating crane feathers and ornate tassels. The outfit includes a small, round lantern with a delicate frame, carried as a handheld accessory.
